footerTagline: Understand your money. Control your future.

hero.badge: A clearer way to manage your money
hero.body: MoneyFlow helps you see where your money goes, stay in control of your spending, plan financial goals, and make better decisions every day.

core.title: Your money should be easier to understand.
core.body: You shouldn't need a spreadsheet full of numbers to understand what's happening with your money. MoneyFlow brings the important parts together in one place.
core.understandBody: See where your money goes, compare your spending, and understand your financial patterns.
core.controlBody: Create budgets, monitor your limits, and get alerts before your spending gets away from you.
core.planBody: Set meaningful financial goals and turn them into progress you can actually see.

features.title: Tools that help you make better money decisions.
features.body: From everyday spending to long-term goals, MoneyFlow gives you a clearer picture of your financial life.
features.transactions: Record income and expenses and keep your financial activity organized.
features.budgets: Set monthly spending limits and know how much you have left.
features.goals: Save toward the things that matter to you and track your progress.
features.reports: Turn your financial activity into useful summaries and trends.
features.insights: Discover spending patterns and changes that are easy to miss.
features.coach: Ask questions about your finances and get helpful, personalized context.

coach.body: MoneyFlow Coach is your Artificial Intelligence (AI) financial companion. Ask questions about your spending, budgets, goals, and financial activity and get answers based on your MoneyFlow context.
coach.q1: Where did I spend the most this month?
coach.q3: How can I reach my goal faster?
coach.q4: How am I doing financially this month?
coach.disclaimer: MoneyFlow Coach is designed to help you understand your financial information. It does not replace professional financial advice.
coach.demoQ1: Why did my spending increase this month?
coach.demoA1: Your spending increased compared with last month. Education and Health were the biggest contributors to the change.
coach.demoQ2: How can I save more for my laptop goal?
coach.demoA2: You're making progress. Your goal is currently at {{saved}} of {{target}}. I can help you look at your spending and identify areas where you may be able to save.

free.title: Free to use. No real money required.
free.body1: MoneyFlow is built to help you understand and plan your finances. You don't deposit money into MoneyFlow, transfer money through the app, or put your savings at risk.
free.body2: Start by tracking your numbers, building better habits, and learning how your financial decisions affect your goals.
free.point1Body: Your real money stays with you.
free.point2Body: Create an account and get started.
free.point3Body: MoneyFlow helps you plan your money.

preview.title: One place for the full picture.
preview.body: Move between your dashboard, transactions, budgets, and goals without losing sight of the bigger picture.

dashboard.label: Dashboard
dashboard.title: See your financial picture at a glance.
dashboard.description: Understand your income, expenses, budgets, and goals without digging through spreadsheets.

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.title: Know where your money is going.
transactions.description: Keep your income and expenses organized so you always know what you spent and why.

budgets.label: Budgets
budgets.title: Stay ahead of your spending.

goals.title: Turn plans into progress.

how.title: Start simple. Build better habits.
how.body: MoneyFlow is built around a simple cycle: track your money, understand it, take control, and plan what comes next.
how.step1Body: Record the income and expenses that make up your everyday financial life.
how.step2Body: See your spending patterns and discover where your money is really going.
how.step3Body: Set budgets, watch your limits, and make more intentional spending decisions.
how.step4Body: Set goals and turn the money you save today into progress toward tomorrow.

statement.title: Stop wondering where your money went.
statement.body: Whether you're managing a monthly income, saving for something important, or simply trying to spend more intentionally, MoneyFlow gives you the clarity to make your next decision with confidence.

final.title: Start understanding your money today.
final.body: Take the first step toward clearer spending, better control, and financial goals you can actually see yourself reaching.

uses.question: What can I use MoneyFlow for?
uses.answer: MoneyFlow helps you track income and expenses, manage budgets, set financial goals, understand spending patterns, and make better day-to-day financial decisions.

skills.question: Do I need to be good with money to use MoneyFlow?
skills.answer: Not at all. MoneyFlow is designed to make your finances easier to understand. You can start with the basics and build better habits as you go.

realMoney.question: Do I need to put real money into MoneyFlow?
realMoney.answer: No. MoneyFlow does not require you to deposit or transfer real money. You use the app to track and understand your finances without putting your money at risk.

goals.question: Can I create savings goals?
goals.answer: Yes. You can create goals for things you want to save for, set a target amount and date, add money toward the goal, and track your progress.

coach.question: What is MoneyFlow Coach?
coach.answer: MoneyFlow Coach is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistant that can answer questions using your MoneyFlow financial context, helping you understand your spending and make more informed decisions.
